name: get-page
description: Reads a Notion page's content as plain text: its title, url and top-level blocks, with headings, lists, to-dos, quotes and code as Markdown-like lines and child pages and databases as their titles in brackets; nested blocks are not read. Answers complete: false when the page holds more blocks than maxPages pages of 100. The page id or URL comes from notion__search-pages-and-databases, or a database row's id from notion__query-database.

pageId.description: A Notion page ID or page URL ending in the page's 32 hexadecimal characters.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of 100-block result pages to read.
